name: AutoBattler
description: Movement-only autopilot for Brotato (MIT fork of BOTato, tested on 1.2.0.1). Auto-moves/dodges/collects during waves; every decision stays manual. Behaviour priors are inferred from measured build traits (no per-character table needed). v2.4.0: DLC-aware — engages cursed enemies (DLC1) and evolved meca/mutant enemies (DLC2) by default, and walks over the Primal Dread evolution consumables (meca/mutant fruit, mutation fruit, meca parts); both stances are adjustable, including an avoid mode. v2.3.0: ranged standoff, trees/hurt fruit, 2-ply planner + hit-adaptive caution. Toggle with Shift+Space.
